blocks.text:
Notification cards take on a soft version of their app’s color.

Inspired by Velvet by NoisyFlake & HiMyNameisUbik. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Notification cards pick up each app’s color

entries.notes: Palette becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0.
